entries.a022436c947dcbd2: This business operates the delivery specialist website and app 'DEMAE-CAN'. Users order products from partner stores through the app or website, and for restaurants without their own delivery function, delivery agents deliver the food under delivery agency services (sharing delivery). Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥39,721 million (down 21.2% year on year). The consolidated subsidiary DEMAE-CAN Communications Co., Ltd. provides services including customer center operations.
